What is it? A power bank designed to perfectly fit the Apple iPhone Duo.

Who is it best for? iPhone Duo owners in need of portable recharging.

Who should skip it? Owners of standard non-folding iPhones.

We’ve reviewed the best magnetic wireless power banks for iPhone and all work with every iPhone since the iPhone 12, with the exception of older iPhone mini models and the odd iPhone 16e that lacks MagSafe altogether. Their compatibility stems from the iPhone retaining its basic shape and magnetic coil arrangement through each series.

The newer iPhone Duo, however, takes a different shape due to its folding nature and unique dimensions. Standard power banks will clamp onto the iPhone Duo but are likely to hang off the bottom of the phone, reducing stability and charging efficiency.

Baseus has therefore designed its latest portable charger, the PicoGo AM72, especially for the iPhone Duo.

How does the PicoGo AM72 fit the iPhone Duo?

Folded, Apple’s iPhone Duo measures 4.64 inches in height, 3.31 inches wide, and 0.44 inches deep (118 x 84 x 11.3mm).

The Baseus PicoGo AM72 measures up as 3.36 x 3.19 x 0.31 inches (85 x 81 x 7.9mm), and weighs in at 4.2oz (119g). It’s a close match in width to the Duo (but wider than a standard iPhone) and nestles at the end of the iPhone without spilling over. Rounded corners make it an appealing fit.

Foundry / David Price

When magnetically fixed to the Duo, there’s no overhang that you’d find if attaching just about any other power bank. This means the two together will slip into your pocket without impacting the wireless charging. The magnetic connection feels strong and secure.

The AM72’s body has an aluminum alloy body, and is available in Silver for the Star White Duo and (from December) Blue for Night Sky.

Simon Jary

How does the PicoGo AM72 perform as a portable charger?

The PicoGo AM72 supports up to 15W Qi2 wireless charging and up to 25W wired charging with the included USB-C cable. The power bank itself recharges at up to 18W over USB-C. To be fair, we haven’t seen a 25W 5K power bank yet, only 10K.

Baseus

The difference in power/speed is around 15 minutes when charging the iPhone Duo from 0-50%: 30 minutes (25W) vs 45 minutes (15W).

Magnetic wireless charging is not yet as powerful—and therefore fast—as wired charging, and so Baseus includes a short USB-C charging cable that does support 25W for when you’re in a hurry. Input power (the speed at which the power bank is recharged itself) is 18W.

Baseus

In terms of battery capacity, the PicoGo AM72 is a 5000mAh (milliamp hours) power bank (aka 5K) but more accurately 19.55Wh (watt hours), which is a little over the average for 5K portable chargers.

We test power banks by running the iPhone’s battery down to 0% and then wirelessly connecting the portable charger to run until it is empty itself. In our wireless recharge test, the PicoGo AM72 took the iPhone Duo from 0% to 60%. The 5K power banks we’ve tested on non-folding iPhones averaged 76%, though the different test phones make a direct comparison difficult. (Battery testing by Macworld’s David Price.)

A 60% recharge from a power bank as slim and short as this one is impressive and should get you to your next static charging point.

Foundry / David Price

Baseus claims that the AM72’s graphene and aerogel insulation layers aid heat dissipation—with its surface temperature staying below 100°F (38°C), which cooler than the industry standard of 118.4°F (48°C). In hand, the power bank did feel a little warm during peak charging, but this is common with powerful wireless chargers.

Thanks to NFC, you can tap your iPhone against the power bank to check battery health and charging status in the Baseus app. Tap again to refresh the charging reading.

Baseus

How much does the Baseus PicoGo AM72 cost?

Available at the time of writing in the U.S. only, the Baseus PicoGo AM72 is priced at $79.99. The darker model will be released in December.

The BMX SolidSafe Duo 5K is another power bank designed for the iPhone Duo, and we’ll be testing this portable charger soon; it’s also priced at $79.99.

Should you buy the Baseus PicoGo AM72 power bank for iPhone Duo

iPhone Duo owners will appreciate this magnetic wireless power bank that’s designed to perfectly fit their folding phone. It’s slim yet attaches strongly to the phone and performed well in our recharge tests. Faster charging is possible with the included USB-C cable.
